The soft_mass enrichment_z and enrichment_change_rate_z measures are selection-enrichment contrasts at the observed selection nodes, not absolute geometric descriptors of the landmark coordinates. The landmark coordinates in teacher_modes.landmarks_A are supplied as fixed reference positions and are not themselves the contrast quantities.

The population, label, and observable for these contrasts are bound as follows: population is the set of observed selection nodes at the 20 supplied landmarks; label is the favorable-versus-comparison selection enrichment (enrichment_z) or its change rate (enrichment_change_rate_z); observable is the native model endpoint world coordinate component (soft_mass, local_dx, local_dy, local_dz, local_cxx, local_cyy, local_czz, local_cxy, local_cxz, local_cyz) at those nodes. The contrasts are signed favorable-versus-comparison coordinate contrasts, not trajectory velocity forces.
